sources.title: FTAI Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
sources.locator: AP segment pp. 38–39; cash-flow policy p. 14
sources.review: AP totals, cost of sales and operating expenses are segment-specific. Cash-flow classification makes EBITDA-to-CFO comparisons incomplete.

sources.title: WestJet: 17 SCI II and 10 AP aircraft
sources.locator: Transaction structure and AP engine supply
sources.review: Aircraft transaction, not delivered or eligible Power cores. Two engines per airframe is an exposure calculation, not an inspected serial census.

sources.title: SCI II warehouse financing
sources.review: $2bn facility plus $1bn contingent accordion. Funding capacity is not deployed capital or FTAI equity.

sources.title: Siemens Energy FY26 pre-close call
sources.locator: pp. 2–3, Gas Services and Grid Technologies
sources.review: Company says gas turbine capacity sold out until FY2028; no separate small-aero slot ledger. Blades/vanes and grid delivery are constraints.

sources.title: Wärtsilä Q1 2026 investor Q&A
sources.review: Some unsold 2027/28 slots remained depending on configuration and order size. An earlier dated observation, not current universal availability.

sources.title: Wärtsilä 282 MW US data-center order
sources.review: Purchased supply with a later operation date. Not a proven 282 MW gap in 2027 and not open FTAI demand.

sources.title: VoltaGrid / Oracle 2,300 MW agreement
sources.locator: Oracle power procurement and gas supply
sources.review: Multi-site competing supply; do not assign all MW to Frontier or add it to overlapping supplier contracts.

sources.title: GEV / Crusoe 29 aeroderivative packages
sources.review: Real aeroderivative procurement; no wholesale assignment to the new Microsoft campus.

sources.title: FTAI Montreal Power configuration engineer
sources.review: Explicit CFM56-5B Power program, BOM and routers. Relative post age not converted into an exact date.

sources.title: FTAI industrial engineer historical listing
sources.review: Power throughput/layout lead, not counted as a verified current opening. No exact historical date.

sources.title: GenSystems Houston IC&E technician
sources.review: FAT, load testing and mobile turbine commissioning. Package portfolio includes equipment beyond Mod-1.

sources.title: GenSystems / Jereh production-planner recruiting post
sources.locator: Recruiter post and Houston manufacturing location
sources.review: MPS, labor/facility capacity and work-order release. Recruiter-post evidence; requisition ID and exact date unavailable.

sources.title: Jereh JT25 equipment identity control
sources.review: JT25 uses GE LM2500 BASE. Its trailer/specs are not an identified Mod-1 fingerprint.

sources.title: EPA ICIS-Air fields and stack-test records
sources.locator: PGM_SYS_ID facility key; stack-test ACTIVITY_ID and date
sources.review: Facility-level test records do not alone identify turbine serials, commercial operation or customer acceptance.

sources.title: ERCOT Batch Zero large-load process
sources.review: Not a blanket state prohibition on grid-connected data centers.

sources.title: Virginia data-center accountability framework
sources.review: Includes proposed on-site gas limits; not automatic regulatory support for unlimited off-grid turbines.
